notes.title: Demo Beta v6.1 Update - Paradox Mode
notes.notes:
Hello agents, here's a new demo patch!

Paradox Mode
Paradoxes are gameplay modifiers that you unlock by beating the par time on set difficulty levels. It can be a cheat mode, a funny visual thing, or a big gameplay modifier. Paradox Mode lets you customize your gameplay with any combination of special options.
Some of you might recognize that type of modifiers as "mutators" which gives a pretty good idea of what the Paradox Mode offers.

Patch notes
Demo - Beta 6.1:
Changes:
- Player auto aim is less strong in 64 Agent.
- Explosive barrels are now also targeted by auto aim.
- Damage push/boosts are now consistent in all difficulty modes (same as in Agent mode).
- Completion times are now saved.

Paradox mode added (beat the par times to unlock paradox options):
- New Paradox: 'Big Heads'
- New Paradox: 'Disable AutoAim'
- New Paradox: 'One Hit Kill'

Will you be able to unlock all the Paradoxes in the demo?

Cheers,
Replicant D6
